# Feedback Log

## 2026-05-03 — Elevate: Follow up from OT PRM 04/26
- Do not list proposed team members by name unless the team was explicitly approved in the meeting
- Action item dates not spoken in the transcript must be flagged as "date not stated — to be confirmed", not omitted or guessed
- One clear owner per action item — pick the accountable person, never write "X + Y" as a joint owner
- Directional alignment is not a decision — only use "Decision:" if something was formally approved or stated as final in the transcript; otherwise use "Direction: [what] — pending formal approval"
- Confluence table cells must be one short line max — never put multi-sentence content inside a cell, it breaks the row
- Move all detailed notes (directions, decisions, discussion) to a dedicated ## Notes section below the table, formatted as bullets
- Never use [brackets] in Confluence markdown — they get escaped; use *(italic)* for AI Generated tags instead
- Never push to Confluence unless the user explicitly says so ("push it" / "go ahead") — do not auto-push after corrections
- update_page replaces the ENTIRE page body — always re-fetch the current page first, preserve all existing sections, and only modify the target sections (Notes, Action items, Decisions)
